in_sanskrit.name: मिथु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Mithu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'madhur', which means 'sweet'. In Hindu mythology, Mithu is an alternate name for Lord Krishna, who is often referred to as 'Madhura Mohana' - the one who attracts with his sweetness. The name Mithu is also used as a term of endearment for someone who is dear, beloved, or sweet.

in_hindi.name: मिथू
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Mithu in Hindi is also derived from the Sanskrit word 'madhur', which means 'sweet'. It is used as a term of endearment for someone who is loved, dear, or beloved. In Hindu mythology, Mithu is an alternate name for Lord Krishna, who is often referred to as 'Madhura Mohana' - the one who attracts with his sweetness.

in_tamil.name: மிது
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Mithu in Tamil is derived from the words 'aaru' and 'maduram', which mean 'love' and 'sweetness' respectively. It is used as a term of endearment for someone who is loved and cherished. In Hindu mythology, Mithu is an alternate name for Lord Murugan, who is often referred to as 'Maduram Raja' - the king of sweetness.

in_telugu.name: మిథు
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Mithu in Telugu is also derived from the Sanskrit word 'madhura', which means 'sweet'. It is used as a term of endearment for someone who is loved, dear, or beloved. In Hindu mythology, Mithu is an alternate name for Lord Venkateswara, who is often referred to as 'Madhura Gaurangam' - the one who is full of sweetness and beauty.

in_marathi.name: Mithu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mithu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Mithu means 'sweet' or 'love'. In Hindu mythology, Mithu is the name of a goddess, representing the sweetness and love in relationships.
